replies.author: Kassiber
replies.body:
working the last days on good workflows for spritesheets (not only pixelart). Iam surprised that it gets not that much attention here on reddit since it seems to be such a fundamental thing for gaming. 

\- keeping the camera still

\- keeping the character consistent

\- keeping the background the same consistent color for chromakey

\- cutting out the charakter (removing the background) without inbleed of the background or loosing too much detail on the edges

\- having good looping animations
